qa: Yes, it triggers. However, this effect can only be activated when that Digimon is blue.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] This Digimon may attack. Then, by trashing 1 card in your hand, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 7000 DP or less. [Your Turn] When your Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them are blue, this Digimon may digivolve into [Apollomon] in the hand with the cost reduced by 2.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
